We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

Job&nbsp;Position: HR Associate

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time



Job Summary


	The HR Associate will support the&nbsp;Human Resources department in implementing HR policies, managing recruitment processes, maintaining employee records, and ensuring smooth day-to-day HR operations within the furniture manufacturing environment.
	The role also focuses on workforce management, especially artisans, factory workers, and administrative staff.


Key Responsibilities


	Assist in sourcing and recruiting skilled furniture artisans (carpenters, upholsterers, polishers) and factory staff.
	Screen applications, schedule interviews, and coordinate hiring processes.
	Conduct background checks and reference verification.
	Facilitate onboarding and orientation for new employees.
	Maintain and update employee files (physical and digital).
	Track employee attendance, leave, and absenteeism.
	Ensure proper documentation of staff across factory and office locations.
	Assist in administering employee benefits and welfare programs.
	Assist in resolving workplace conflicts and disciplinary issues.
	Promote a positive work environment across factory and office staff.
	Ensure compliance with labor laws and company policies.
	Assist in performance appraisal processes for staff.
	Monitor probationary employees and support confirmation processes.
	Maintain performance records and reports.
	Prepare HR reports (headcount, turnover, attendance).
	Support HR projects and initiatives.
	Perform other administrative duties as assigned.


Qualifications &amp; Requirements


	Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
	2&ndash;3 years of HR experience (preferably in manufacturing or production environment).




Salary
N220,000 monthly.



Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their application to: peopleeandculture@taeillo.com using the Job Position as the subject of the email.&nbsp;

HR Associate Job at Taeillo Furniture




        
    

        
        At Taeillo, we provide well-designed, functional, durable, affordable, and sustainable home furnishing solutions to African millennials with big dreams on a budget. 


 
     

            
    





We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: HR Associate

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time



Job Summary


	The HR Associate will support the Human Resources department in implementing HR policies, managing recruitment processes, maintaining employee records, and ensuring smooth day-to-day HR operations within the furniture manufacturing environment.
	The role also focuses on workforce management, especially artisans, factory workers, and administrative staff.


Key Responsibilities


	Assist in sourcing and recruiting skilled furniture artisans (carpenters, upholsterers, polishers) and factory staff.
	Screen applications, schedule interviews, and coordinate hiring processes.
	Conduct background checks and reference verification.
	Facilitate onboarding and orientation for new employees.
	Maintain and update employee files (physical and digital).
	Track employee attendance, leave, and absenteeism.
	Ensure proper documentation of staff across factory and office locations.
	Assist in administering employee benefits and welfare programs.
	Assist in resolving workplace conflicts and disciplinary issues.
	Promote a positive work environment across factory and office staff.
	Ensure compliance with labor laws and company policies.
	Assist in performance appraisal processes for staff.
	Monitor probationary employees and support confirmation processes.
	Maintain performance records and reports.
	Prepare HR reports (headcount, turnover, attendance).
	Support HR projects and initiatives.
	Perform other administrative duties as assigned.


Qualifications & Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
	2–3 years of HR experience (preferably in manufacturing or production environment).




Salary
N220,000 monthly.



Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their application to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Facility and Admin Officer Job at Taeillo Furniture




        
    

        
        At Taeillo, we provide well-designed, functional, durable, affordable, and sustainable home furnishing solutions to African millennials with big dreams on a budget. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Facility and Admin Officer

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	The Facilities and Admin Officer is responsible for preserving the good condition of company infrastructure and ensuring that all facilities are safe, compliant, and well-functioning.
	This role combines hands-on facilities oversight with proactive planning, keeping equipment, utilities, and office spaces running smoothly at all times.


Job Responsibilities


	Ensure that basic facilities are well-maintained and kept in good working condition.
	Ensure that facilities meet government regulations and environmental, health, and security standards.
	Supervise the supply and distribution of utilities - diesel, water and the repairs and maintenance of company facilities.
	Regularly inspect company properties, and maintain and update the inspection schedule.
	Supervise the installation, movement, repair, and removal of equipment and utilities within the building.
	Ensure monthly facility inspections and audits of office facilities are carried out.
	Monitor and evaluate energy (PHCN/generator) and water consumption across facilities.
	Create and maintain a database of equipment and facilities servicing schedules.
	Ensure planned maintenance programs for office equipment, and preventive maintenance of facility equipment, are carried out as required.
	Perform environmental hazard management, planning, and remediation.
	Other duties as assigned.


Job Requirements


	HND / B.Sc Degree in Electrical Engineering, Facilities Management, or a related field.
	3-5 years of experience in Facilites Management
	Knowlege of electrical work and repairs is highly required
	Proven experience as a Facilities Officer in a manufacturing industry (factory setting)
	Well-versed in the electrical field, engineering operations and facilities management best practices.Specification
	Intrinsically motivated by the mission of Taeillo.
	Results-oriented and pragmatic, with exceptional quantitative and analytical ability and strong attention to detail.
	A driven, independent thinker and leader who can juggle multiple projects simultaneously amid fast-changing priorities.
	High level of integrity and dependability, with a strong sense of urgency.
	A focus on execution — willing and able to solve problems.
	Flexibility to roll up your sleeves and tackle problems and projects as they arise, setting out clear structure, method, and outcomes independently.


Salary
N200,000 - N300,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their application to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Chelis has completely revolutionized the school supply industry in Nigeria because of the passion, creativity, total commitment and dedication we bring into our business to achieve our vision of contributing significantly to the provision of top quality, world class education in Nigeria. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Administrative Officer
Job Location: Surulere, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Administrative Officer to join our growing team at the Head Office in Surulere, Lagos State.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting the day-to-day administrative and financial operations of Chelis Group and its sister companies, ensuring efficiency, accuracy, compliance, and the smooth running of office activities.
	The ideal candidate should possess strong administrative, organizational, and record-management skills, with the ability to multitask effectively in a fast-paced environment.
	The role involves managing administrative processes, supporting financial transactions, maintaining records, and ensuring compliance with company policies and relevant regulations.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage general office operations, supplies, correspondence, and filing systems.
	Support basic accounting functions, including invoicing, expense tracking, and petty cash management.
	Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial and administrative records.
	Prepare reports, presentations, and other business documentation as required.
	Coordinate schedules, meetings, appointments, and travel arrangements.
	Liaise with vendors, service providers, and external partners to ensure office needs are met efficiently.
	Assist in monitoring compliance with internal policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
	Drive on official assignments when required.
	Perform other duties as assigned to support the smooth operation of the office.


Requirements


	B.Sc./HND in Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field.
	Minimum of two (2) years of post-NYSC work experience in administrative and accounting roles.
	Proficiency in accounting software and the Microsoft Office Suite.
	Strong attention to detail and accuracy in financial data management.
	Excellent organizational, time-management, and multitasking skills.
	Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
	Residence within close proximity or reasonable commuting distance to Bode Thomas, Surulere, Lagos State will be an added advantage.
	Willingness to work two (2) Saturdays per month.


Salary
